summary: Documentation and test change with no runtime behaviour change. The source edits in client-v3.ts and wasm-inline.ts are JSDoc and comments only; the raw decrypt/bulkDecrypt methods remain bare delegations with no Date reconstruction, exactly as at base. README and the stash-encryption agent skill (which ships inside the `stash` CLI tarball) now document the raw-vs-model Date boundary and correct the stated reason; I checked the new claims against the code (raw paths delegate unchanged, bulkEncrypt is typed by { table, column }) and found them accurate. New runtime and type-level tests pin the existing boundary; they were not run here (no node_modules, no CI results). The changeset patch-bumps @cipherstash/stack and stash, which publishes doc-only releases. No material failure scenario identified.

behaviour_changes.description: JSDoc on EncryptionClient.decrypt/bulkDecrypt (native v3 client) and WasmEncryptionClient.decrypt/bulkDecrypt now states that date/timestamp columns come back as stored strings, and replaces the incorrect 'lone ciphertext carries no column identity' rationale with a static-typing rationale. Code bodies are unchanged.

Shipped guidance changes: packages/stack/README.md and skills/stash-encryption/SKILL.md (bundled into the stash CLI and copied into customer repos by `stash init`) add a raw-path Date warning and stop describing bulkEncrypt as an untyped passthrough.

Adds runtime tests pinning that the v3 wrapper's decrypt/bulkDecrypt return stored strings unchanged, and type tests pinning that raw paths resolve to JsPlaintext (no Date arm) while decryptModel(row, table) resolves Date and the table-less form resolves string. Existing stubs re-cast from EncryptionClient to the native client parameter type; no assertion was removed.
A changeset patch-bumps @cipherstash/stack and stash, so merging produces published patch releases whose only content difference is documentation/skills.

evidence.claim: All hunks in client-v3.ts and wasm-inline.ts are comment/JSDoc additions or rewrites; no executable lines change.
decrypt and bulkDecrypt are bare delegations to the underlying client with no Date mapping, matching the new documentation.
bulkEncrypt is generic over Table/Col and takes BulkEncryptPayloadFor<Col> with { table, column }, supporting the doc correction that it is typed like encrypt.
WASM decrypt returns the FFI plaintext cast to WasmPlaintext with no Date reconstruction.
WASM bulkDecrypt decrypts via the fallible batch FFI and returns plaintexts with no Date reconstruction.
The CLI build copies the monorepo skills/ directory into dist/skills so stash init can install them into user repositories.
New runtime tests assert decrypt and bulkDecrypt return the stored ISO string (not a Date) and forward payloads unchanged. Not run.
New type tests assert raw decrypt resolves to JsPlaintext without a Date arm, decryptModel with table yields Date, and table-less yields string. Not run.
Typecheck runs only over __tests__/**/*.test-d.ts; runtime *.test.ts suites are not typechecked, so the stub re-cast in typed-client-v3.test.ts has no CI type effect.
Changeset patch-bumps @cipherstash/stack and stash, and states no behaviour change.
Table-less passthrough maps are unchanged; only the surrounding comment was rewritten.
typed-client-v3.test.ts usually co-changes with src/encryption/v3.ts, absent here; expected because this change adds tests for existing behaviour rather than altering v3.ts.
